values.nodeInfo: 用於剛體碰撞的 2D 物理引擎。

shapes.shapeType:
Box: A Box Collision Shape
Circle: A Circular Collision Shape
Simple Polygon: A 'best fit' convex polygon with up to 8 sides will be created to represent the shape.
Complex Polygon: Accurate collision for concave polygons - automatically triangulated for precise collision detection.
Chain: A **still** one sided collision object that represents a chain of points. This is suitable for open paths.
Chain (reversed): As above but collisions happen on the other side of the shape.
Soft Body: Deformable physics body made from spring-connected particles. Supports complex polygons with holes.
shapes.collisionGroups: Comma-separated group names this body belongs to (e.g., 'terrain,solid'). Leave empty to belong to all groups. Use 'none' to belong to no groups.
shapes.collidesWith: Comma-separated group names this body collides with (e.g., 'terrain,solid'). Leave empty to collide with all groups. Use 'none' to collide with nothing.
shapes.maxFixturesPerBody: Maximum number of triangular fixtures to create for Complex Polygon shapes. Higher values give more accurate collision for highly detailed shapes, at the cost of performance.
shapes.stiffness: Spring frequency in Hz (vibrations per second). Higher values make the soft body stiffer.
shapes.damping: Damping ratio. Controls how quickly oscillations settle.
shapes.pressure: Internal pressure for volume preservation. Higher values push particles outward to maintain the body's shape.
shapes.shapeMatching: Strength of shape preservation. Gently pulls particles toward their original relative positions to help restore the body's shape after deformation.
shapes.particleRadius: Size of the particles that are used to simulate the soft body. Smaller values give finer detail but more particles - smaller values are much harder to control.
shapes.maxStretch: Maximum allowed stretch of spring connections as a multiple of rest length. Lower values maintain shape better under impact but may be less flexible. 2.0 = springs can stretch to double their rest length.

fadeTime: How long it takes the color to fade, in seconds.
fadeToThirdColor: Instead of fading back to the original color, the shape will fade to a third color.
useCollisionIndex:
The collision number will be used instead of the body index to get unique values for each collision.
Use this mode when you want each collision to be different, rather than for each body to be different.
specificCollisions: When on, the event will only be triggered for specific collisions. These can be set in the Collision Numbers box.
specificIndices: The collisions you want the event to happen for. E.g '0,2' will mean the event is triggered for the first and third collision.

breakingDuration: Number of consecutive frames under stress before breaking (for Time mode).
stressThreshold: Stress level required to count towards breaking duration (for Time mode) as a percentage of breaking force.

tension: Joint flexibility. When 0, the pin is rigid (default behavior - bodies can rotate freely around the pin point). When greater than 0, the joint becomes a flexible weld that resists rotation with spring-like behavior.
dampingRatio: Reduces oscillation in flexible joints. 0 = no damping (springy), 1 = critical damping (smooth, no bounce).
stretchLimit: Multiplies the Rotational Limits to determine the extra allowance beyond each limit before breaking.
breakingDuration: Number of consecutive frames under stress before breaking (for Time mode).
stressThreshold: Stress level required to count towards breaking duration (for Time mode) as a percentage of breaking force.
reportStress: Enable stress level reporting for debugging and visual feedback.

breakingDuration: Number of consecutive frames under stress before breaking (for Time mode).
stressThreshold: Stress level required to count towards breaking duration (for Time mode) as a percentage of breaking force.
reportStress: Enable stress level reporting for debugging and visual feedback.

falloffs: Connect or add Falloffs to determine a Field's strength based on position.
affectsGroups: Comma-separated collision groups this field affects. Use 'none' to affect no groups.

spiralStrength: Tangential force strength. Makes bodies orbit around the vortex center.
centripetalStrength: Radial force strength. Positive pulls inward toward center, negative pushes outward.
angularStrength: Spin/rotation force applied to bodies on their own axis. Makes bodies rotate as they move through the vortex.

buoyancyStrength: Multiplier for buoyant force. 1.0 = physically accurate, higher values create stronger upward push.
dragCoefficient: Resistance to movement through the fluid. Higher values slow bodies down more (opposes velocity).
liftCoefficient: Force perpendicular to velocity direction. Creates swirling/spiraling motion in the fluid. 0 = no lift.
angularDrag: Resistance to rotation in the fluid. Higher values slow down spinning.
enableUprighting: Apply rotational force to make bodies orient themselves to a target angle (self-righting).
uprightingStrength: Strength of the righting torque. Higher values make bodies rotate to upright angle faster.
uprightAngle: Target angle in degrees that bodies try to rotate towards.
surfaceTension: Enable special forces when bodies enter/exit the fluid region (surface pop effects).
surfaceTensionForce: Impulse strength when crossing the fluid boundary. Creates splash-like entry effects.
surfaceThickness: Depth of the surface tension detection zone (currently unused in full-submersion mode).

values.nodeInfo: 對形狀套用路徑跟隨力。

pathToFollow: Connect a Shape to define the path that bodies will follow.
captureForce: Strength of the force pulling bodies towards the path.
flowForce: Strength of the force moving bodies along the path tangent.
captureMargin: Distance from the path where capture forces apply.
flowMargin: Distance from the path where flow forces apply.
flowVariance: Add randomness to flow direction for more natural motion.
captureGraph: Control how capture force attenuates with distance from the path.
flowGraph: Control how flow force attenuates with distance from the path.
velocityDamping: Opposes body velocity to prevent oscillation and instability. Higher values create more stable but slower motion.

values.nodeInfo: 沿路徑中所有輪廓移動起始點（一條路徑可包含多個輪廓）。
反轉路徑中輪廓的方向（一條路徑可包含多個輪廓）。
設定路徑外部輪廓的方向，並在需要時反轉其內部輪廓。
根據方向從路徑中移除輪廓。
參考智慧資料夾中包含的素材（圖片、影片、音訊等）。
將圖層轉換為高對比的黑白表現。
降低圖層的色彩變化以建立低色深外觀。
將圖片中顏色的邊界轉換為線條。
模擬透過某些類型鏡頭觀看圖片時的光線衰減特性。
調整色相、飽和度與明度。
增加邊緣像素之間的對比度，使其呈現更銳利的外觀。
新增細微顆粒以模擬底片的視覺效果。

logColorSpace: Apply the Grain in the Log color space

values.nodeInfo: 根據速度的方向和大小套用線性模糊
從一條線延伸像素以建立塗抹效果。
建立動態穿越效果。
透過計算點格之間的距離產生細胞圖案。

equidistantEdges: Style must be Euclidean, Type must be Normal

values.nodeInfo: 為形狀新增發光效果，並可個別控制 RGB 通道。
以其他通道的值取代紅色、綠色、藍色和 Alpha 通道。
將圖層轉換為黑白。
調整圖層的亮度與對比。
變形形狀以建立 3D 透視的錯覺。
擠出形狀以呈現深度效果。
從形狀中擷取特定的子網格。
使用此功能取得子網格中任何形狀的變換（位置、旋轉、縮放）。
在路徑交叉處分佈點。
建立形狀的「堆疊」或自訂佈局。

offset: Offset is added to the final value.
padding: Padding is added between each accumulated step.

values.nodeInfo: 從圖片素材中取樣色彩值並用於驅動其他屬性。

helper: Use any Transform (e.g a rectangle with the image on) to help position the image.

values.nodeInfo: 在形狀周圍建立多重筆畫。
使用 JavaScript 設定屬性、建立自訂模擬、分佈等。
使用 JavaScript 建立形狀。
使用 JavaScript 控制或影響粒子。
使用 JavaScript 建立自訂粒子發射器。
使用 JavaScript 變形形狀。
在 Forge 動力學模擬中對形狀的目前速度套用反向力。
為幾何新增分割並平滑產生的路徑。
定義用於字體陣列的字型及其字重。
存取子網格中的路徑長度，以驅動任何其他屬性。
擷取文字素材的內容，用於文字形狀或 JavaScript 圖層。

attributes.label: 标签
useRelPlacement: 在絕對定位和相對定位之間切換
absTime: 在絕對定位模式中使用
relTime: 在相對定位模式中使用（ 0 ：第一幀， 1 ：最後一幀）

value.nodeInfo: 按程序在時間上定位子圖層。
在輪廓自相交處為路徑新增缺口。

gapWidth: 交叉點周圍的缺口大小。可以將行為連接到此屬性。

value.nodeInfo: 建立帶有 IK 控制的骨骼用於角色綁定/動畫。
將形狀綁定到骨骼。
使用時間標記、BPM 或秒來隨時間累積或觸發值。
使用此工具根據輸入顏色和對比度提供不同的輸出顏色。
將正弦、鋸齒和方波等波形效果套用到形狀。

numberOfWaves: 每個輪廓的完整波形數量。
samplePoints: This controls the quality of the output curves. The higher the value the higher the quality, but the slower the calculation.

value.nodeInfo: 僅用少量關鍵幀為形狀新增多種動畫。

progressMode: 用單個控制器控制每個動畫，或用單獨的控制器控制動畫的每個方面。
alternateDirection: 反轉每隔一條路徑的方向。需要勾選「使用級別」。
offsetAnimationMode: 將動畫對齊到圖層的可見範圍。
automaticTimeOffset: 取消勾選後，將行為（如錯開）連接到動畫時間偏移以自訂。
reverseTimeOffset: 勾選後，反轉每個子網格的動畫順序。
zoom: Rotation animations use an internal camera, you can change the lens angle with this control, lower numbers such as 100 create a very wide angle lens effect.
attributes.timingHelp: 必須勾選「使用級別」才能使用時間偏移功能。
attributes.animationModeHelp: 使用下方的各個「進度」屬性來建立更加自訂的動畫。
attributes.useLevelsHelp: Levels are, for example, how you can animate the individual Shapes in a Duplicator, or the Lines/Words/Characters of a Text Shape.
attributes.offsetAnimationModeHelp: When 'Start at In Frame' is selected, animation starts at the layer's In Point. When 'Finish at Out Frame' is selected, animation ends at the layer's Out Point.

value.nodeInfo: 從包含開放路徑的兩個形狀建立包含封閉路徑的形狀。

attributes.mergeHelp: 新增兩條開放路徑，合併將它們連接成一條封閉路徑。

value.nodeInfo: 用針線效果填充封閉路徑。

distance: 針線之間的距離。可以將行為連接到此屬性。
spread: 隨著針線沿路徑推進而展開線條。
disconnectionMultiplier: 確定針線之間的最大距離，超過此距離將開始新的輪廓。

value.nodeInfo: 建立複雜的描邊組合。

strokeCount: 設定要新增的描邊數量。

value.nodeInfo: 將圖像或形狀圖層轉換為輪廓。

outputBeziers: 輸出貝茲曲線而非多邊形。
cleanupPath: 移除彼此非常接近的點。
filterPathSize: 移除最大尺寸小於路徑尺寸值的路徑。

value.nodeInfo: 根據另一個圖層的亮度值模糊一個圖層。

maxBlurAmount: 設定亮度為 1 （白色）時的模糊量。
minBlurAmount: 設定亮度為 0 （黑色）時的模糊量。
debugMode: 選擇算繪到視口的檢視。
controlShape: 連接一個形狀以從中取樣亮度。

value.nodeInfo: 將路徑點相互推開。

iterations: 套用鬆弛處理的次數。較高的值產生更強的分離效果。
radius: 使點相互推開的距離範圍。

value.nodeInfo: 透過平均位置來平滑路徑點。

cutoffFrequency: 控制平滑程度。較低的值產生更平滑的結果。

value.nodeInfo: 沿法線或自訂角度置換點。

angle: 置換方向的角度（以度為單位）。
frequency: 選擇每第 N 個點。0 表示所有點。

value.nodeInfo: 透過從現有路徑尖端生成新的路徑子網格來建立分支結構。使用迭代模式建立靜態碎形，或使用幀模式建立動畫生長。

mode: 分裂模式：迭代（靜態）或幀（動畫）。
iterations: 迭代模式的遞迴迭代次數。新分支本身也可以分裂。
preventReSplit: 防止同一路徑多次分裂（僅幀模式）。
maxTotalBranches: 建立的最大分支數（僅幀模式）。防止指數增長的安全限制。
splitLength: 允許分裂的最小路徑長度（長度閾值模式）。
splitProbability: 每幀的分裂機率（隨機模式）。
splitSeed: 用於確定性隨機分裂的隨機種子。
splitCurvatureAngle: 觸發分裂的最小轉角角度（曲率角度模式）。
branchAngle: 分支與父路徑垂線的角度。
branchArcSweepAngle: 弧形分支的掃描角度（以度為單位）。
branchCurvature: 貝茲分支控制點的曲率強度。

value.nodeInfo: 連接變形器以建立繪圖機器或差異生長等迭代效果。

startFrame: 求解器初始化或重設的幀。
preRollIterations: 在起始幀及之前的所有幀對輸入幾何套用的變形器迭代次數。
keepPreviousMeshes: 保留為子網格的先前幀結果數量。建立類似運動模糊的拖尾效果。僅在幀模式下有效。
reverseOrder: 反轉子網格的順序（最舊的在前而非最新的在前）。
